messages:
Casey: tiny highly scientific experiment: i asked the model to write a Yelp review from the perspective of our office coffee machine. it has opinions. 
Ivy: omg the coffee machine review please 
Malik: prompt used? i need to replicate this immediately. :joy: 
Casey: 'You are a weary espresso machine with standards. Write a scathing but witty 3-line Yelp review of the humans who kneel before your bean hopper.' 
June: output highlight: 'Two baristas promised crema and delivered existential dread. 2/5—wouldn't recommend during Monday standups.' 
StickerBot: :sticker: Suggested sticker text: "My roast, my rules." :coffee: 
Ivy: can we anthropomorphize other infra? printer that judges your commit messages? router that demands quarterly praise? 
Malik: committee proposal: "Anthro Friday" where team picks an appliance and we let the model riff. low-effort morale boost. 
Casey: also submission: the coffee machine requested a raise (more beans) and recurring maintenance checks. 
June: poll: would you let an LLM write a persona for an office appliance? react :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no, reply 'maybe' for indecisive people 
Malik: :thumbsup: 
Ivy: maybe 
StickerBot: :robot_face: logging votes to the meme ledger.
